english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for the sustained rise in Earth’s average temperature.
Use this when focusing on human-driven global warming in everyday discussion rather than on climate changes more broadly.

examples.english: Global warming is making summers hotter year by year.
examples.traditional: 全球暖化令夏天一年比一年熱。
examples.jyutping: cyun4 kau4 nyun5 faa3 ling6 haa6 tin1 jat1 nin4 bei2 jat1 nin4 jit6

examples.english: Global warming is making summers hotter, and air-conditioning bills have gone up a lot because of climate change.
